allowed_actions.description: Read source files, docs, and schemas.
Read project documentation and policy files.
Inspect Prisma models and admin forms.
Map admin UI and admin route structure.
Write audit, review, or planning reports under ai/reports.
Prepare or apply changes limited to draft-safe fields on first-wave entities.
Generate review packets for human approval.
Describe sensitive changes without applying them.
Summarize a planned diff for review.
Explain why a requested change is risky.

forbidden_actions.description: Edit pricing entities or commercial price values without explicit review.
Change calculator pricing code or rule engine behavior.
Change route protection or middleware behavior.
Change global settings or system-level admin configuration.
Change entity routing slugs without review.
Apply sensitive SEO metadata changes without review.
Modify production business logic routes in the first foundation phase.
